answer: Jury diversity is the cheap filter. Draw seven graders, require four distinct subnets and three client versions. Fail the rule and the claim is voided and redrawn. A lazy operator clones one image on one host, so every panel it draws collapses on the subnet test. Signal from a single machine never counts twice. Relic answers from earlier epochs cannot be resubmitted because the receipt binds the epoch nonce. Redraws spiral, and each one costs the claimant a full epoch of waiting for a payout that may never clear.
